formal_statement: ∀ (q N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), 2 ≤ q → N = q ^ 2 + q + 1 → (∀ l : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => I p l)).card = q + 1) → (∀ p p' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → ∃! l : Fin N, I p l ∧ I p' l) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = decide (∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true)) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (N + N) D ∧ (∀ y : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) D y = decide (∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ y (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ y (Fin.natAdd N l) = true)) ∧ D.size ≤ C.size ∧ PEqualNP.ReadK.IsReadK (N + N) D 2
plain_statement: A plane of order q >= 2: N = q^2+q+1 points and lines, q+1 points on each line, two points on exactly one line; inputs the N points then the N lines. For every circuit C of AND/OR gates only, each reading exactly two earlier wires, no constants, true exactly on inputs with some incident point and line both on, there is a circuit D of the same kind computing the same function, with at most as many gates as C, that is read-2: each incident pair {p, l} has a proof tree in the circuit (both inputs at an AND, one at an OR) reading x_p at most twice and y_l at most twice.
title: On a plane of order q, every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for incidence can be replaced by a read-2 one with at most as many gates
